main_text.l: Mollis est vel sperma Ceti, & Hælosanthos veterum, vel ambra odorata.
Obsidianus est ambra vera, Ebenum sossile, & lapis Thracius.
Pix mineralis est Asphalthus vel Piasphalthus.
Asphalthus est Sodomæa, vel Carthaginensis Cerea.
Pisasphalthus seu Mumia est simplex vel sepulchralis.
Geodes est terra ampelitis, vel carbo fossilis.
Terra ampelitis est Communis vel Pharmacitis.
Carbo fossilis est Asphaltotes vel Xylodes.
Lithodes est lapis fossilis bitumineus & marmarodis.
Marmarodis est Belemnites & Ebur fossile, vel Balanites.

page.notes: Long s and ligatures normalised to plain letters. Uncertain: "Obsidian⁹" (superscript 9 as printed, likely -us abbreviation); "Hælosanthos" with Greek word printed in Latin letters, copied as printed. Catchword "Bala-" is the first word of the next page.
